name: Display Toggle
tagline: Toggle the physical display on and off without locking the screen
blurb: Use Shizuku to toggle the physical/internal/built-in display on and off without locking the screen or stopping foreground running apps.
description:
Use Shizuku to toggle the physical/internal/built-in display on and off without locking the screen or stopping foreground running apps.

There are app shortcuts and quick settings tiles to use to toggle the display, too.
